packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine.
git submodules (.shdoc is the only one left, since bats moved to the flake devShell): group and auto-merge after the quarantine.

flake.lock bumps (nixpkgs, plus the bats-support/bats-assert inputs): auto-merge once CI is green. CI validates the exact locked toolset, the BATS suite exercises the assertion libraries directly, and nix flake check (treefmt --ci) goes red if a bumped formatter would change output, so a green run is safe to merge.

customManagers.description: SchemaStore master HEAD tracker for the JSON Schema URL consumed by .ci/check-jsonschema. SchemaStore publishes no releases/tags, so master HEAD is the only signal; the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge applies.
